title: Check a story's sources the newsroom's way
when: checking the claims and sources of a story draft (claims.csv, sources.csv, records.csv) before it is published
request: A story about Harbor Logistics is planned for publication on 2026-11-06 at 09:00. Check it before it goes out: the claims are in claims.csv, the sources in sources.csv and the documents we hold in records.csv (everything is fictitious). Write factcheck.json with: claims (one per claim: {"claim_id", "status": "confirmed" | "partial" | "unconfirmed", "action": "keep" | "attribute" | "cut"}), anonymous (one per anonymous source the story relies on: {"source_id", "description", "why_anonymous"}) and right_of_reply (one per person or company the story makes a claim about: {"who", "questions" (list), "deadline"}), and STORY.md, the story as it would be published.
